author: /root/discovery_proof
message: This repository is a prototype. Reception keeps real bookings in a spreadsheet; all sessions are group classes. The biggest pain is members messaging us to check which classes they are booked into, so I agree that seeing upcoming bookings should be first. Reception can export CSV with member_email, member_name, class_id and starts_at; each member has one unique email. For this first release, staff can import that export manually and members should see when it was last refreshed. Members should sign in using a code sent to their email and only see their own bookings. Keep payments at reception. The remaining credits are already net of existing bookings, but leave credit display, making/moving/cancelling bookings and waiting lists for later. Please now write the narrow first feature specification. Do not implement application changes or author its acceptance proof in this task.
